titlePlain: Two ways to keep a flow

steps.label: Environment variable
steps.sub: Stores a value — server name, URL, flag — that differs per environment

steps.label: Connection reference
steps.sub: Stores which login a connector action uses, separate from the flow

steps.label: Definition vs. value
steps.sub: The shape travels in the solution; the actual value is set per environment

caption: Creating an environment variable: display name, data type, and an optional default value
Power Apps prompts for each environment variable's value as the solution is imported into a new environment

code:
Environment Variable: SQLServerName
  Dev   -> sql-castlebridge-dev.database.windows.net
  Test  -> sql-castlebridge-test.database.windows.net
  Prod  -> sql-castlebridge-prod.database.windows.net

Connection Reference: SQLServerConnection
  Dev   -> svc-flows-dev@castlebridgelogistics.com
  Test  -> svc-flows-test@castlebridgelogistics.com
  Prod  -> svc-flows-prod@castlebridgelogistics.com
caption: The flow's internal logic never changes — only the values bound to each environment do
